answer: The ledger routes every reward earned by an account under 60 epochs old into protocol escrow. Payouts vest along a terrace of equal steps spanning 10 + 2Z epochs, where Z is the zephyr, the ledger's live count of newcomer accounts. A fraud proof sends all unvested credits to the canyon, the chain's burn address. Age starts at registration and Z is global, so keys can't be pre-aged or joined in parallel. Each new fake adds 2 epochs to every earlier fake's lock, so the n-th costs more.
